# online-courses.club

> > A VFX and digital art course marketplace offering group-buy access to premium creative courses from platforms like Coloso, Rebelway, and Gumroad.

online-courses.club is a curated course aggregator specializing in visual effects, character design, illustration, and 3D modeling. The platform facilitates group-buy access to professional creative education, making premium courses more affordable through shared purchases.

## Key Topics

- Group-buy courses
- VFX training
- Houdini tutorials
- Digital art
- Character design
- Coloso
- Rebelway
- Gumroad
- Compositing
- Pixel art
- 3D modeling
- Creative education
- Beginner-friendly
- Course marketplace
- Limited-time deals

## Featured Courses

- [Sci-Fi FX in Houdini](https://online-courses.club/sci-fi-fx-in-houdini-rebelway-jason-slabber-group-buy): Sci-Fi FX in Houdini course by Jason Slabber via Rebelway.
- [Professional Compositing Techniques](https://online-courses.club/01-professional-compositing-techniques-en-gumroad-aitor-echeveste-group-buy): Professional compositing techniques course by Aitor Echeveste.
- [Practice Makes Perfect: Mastering Anime Character Illustrations](https://online-courses.club/practice-makes-perfect-mastering-anime-character-illustrations-coloso-lunarmimi-group-buy): Anime character illustration course by Lunarmimi via Coloso.
- [Marvel's The Art of Storytelling](https://online-courses.club/marvels-the-art-of-storytelling-marvel-proko-group-buy): Comic storytelling and art instruction course by Marvel via Proko.
- [Charming Characters and Romance Scene Illustration](https://online-courses.club/charming-characters-and-romance-scene-illustration-coloso-jii-group-buy): Character and romance illustration course by Jii via Coloso.
- [Master Vibrant Pixel Art and Dynamic Animations](https://online-courses.club/master-vibrant-pixel-art-and-dynamic-animations-%e8%89%b2%e5%bd%a9%e3%81%8c%e9%9a%9b%e7%ab%8b%e3%81%a4%e3%83%94%e3%82%af%e3%82%bb%e3%83%ab%e3%82%a2%e3%83%bc%e3%83%88%e3%81%ae%e5%9f%ba%e7%a4%8e): Pixel art and animation fundamentals course by Nanamiyuki via Coloso.
- [Creating Expressive Characters: Professional Impasto Painting](https://online-courses.club/creating-expressive-characters-professional-impasto-painting-%e5%8e%9a%e5%a1%97%e3%82%8a%e3%81%a7%e5%ae%8c%e6%88%90%e3%81%99%e3%82%8b%e8%a1%a8%e6%83%85%e8%b1%8a%e3%81%8b%e3%81%aa%e3%82%ad%e3%83%a3): Expressive character painting course by Pipi via Coloso.
- [Mastering Mood & Ambiance in Digital Illustration](https://online-courses.club/mastering-mood-ambiance-in-digital-illustration-%e7%a9%ba%e6%b0%97%e6%84%9f%e3%82%92%e6%bc%94%e5%87%ba%e3%81%97%e3%81%9f%e7%be%8e%e3%81%97%e3%81%84%e4%b8%80%e6%9e%9a%e7%b5%b5%e3%81%ae%e5%88%b6): Digital illustration mood and atmosphere course by Kina Kazuharu.
